name: Narset Transcendent
oracle_text:
+1: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a noncreature, nonland card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand.
−2: When you next cast an instant or sorcery spell from your hand this turn, it gains rebound. (Exile the spell as it resolves. At the beginning of your next upkeep, you may cast that card from exile without paying its mana cost.)
−9: You get an emblem with "Your opponents can't cast noncreature spells."
blocked_sentences: −9: You get an emblem with "Your opponents can't cast noncreature spells."

needs.what: a spell filter on the player-wide cant_cast_spells static, so an emblem can say "Your opponents can't cast noncreature spells" (affects_player: opponent, spells matching not_types: [Creature] are refused at cast time, creature spells still allowed)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cant_cast_spells is total: the loader refuses 'affects' or 'amount' on it and nothing reads a spell filter, so it would stop creature spells too (a strictly stronger lock). cant_cast_spells_from_zones filters by zone, not spell type, and spell_cost_increase only taxes rather than forbids
